P.text: A user cancels a withdrawal request via cancelWithdrawal, recording the associated HYPE value (totalHypeValueReturned) in _cancelledWithdrawalAmount; subsequently an account with MANAGER_ROLE privileges calls redelegateWithdrawnHYPE, which reads _cancelledWithdrawalAmount, resets it to zero, and re-delegates this HYPE amount through _distributeStake with operation type OperationType.SpotDeposit.
P.evidence_quote: When a user cancels a withdrawal request (via the `cancelWithdrawal` function), the associated HYPE value (i.e., `totalHypeValueReturned`) is recorded in `_cancelledWithdrawalAmount`. Subsequently, an account with `MANAGER_ROLE` privileges can call the `redelegateWithdrawnHYPE` function, which reads the value of `_cancelledWithdrawalAmount`, resets it to zero, and re-delegates this HYPE amount through the `_distributeStake` function with the operation type `OperationType.SpotDeposit`.

I.text: For SpotDeposit and RebalanceDeposit types, the conversion should properly account for the remainder from amount % 1e10 (the portion lost due to precision truncation), as is done for UserDeposit (see L464), so the remainder is added back to hypeBuffer or included in the truncatedAmount sent to L1.
I.evidence_quote: However, unlike the handling of `UserDeposit` (see L464), the conversion process for `SpotDeposit` and `RebalanceDeposit` does not properly account for the remainder from `amount % 1e10`, i.e., the portion lost due to precision truncation. This remainder (less than `1e10` wei HYPE, equivalent to less than `1e-8` HYPE) is neither added back to `hypeBuffer` nor included in the `truncatedAmount` sent to L1.

V.text: Each redelegateWithdrawnHYPE call loses _cancelledWithdrawalAmount % 1e10 HYPE from the re-delegation process; this HYPE remains in the StakingManager contract outside normal accounting (not recorded in totalStaked, not explicitly tracked in hypeBuffer, not delegated to validators), accumulating and becoming permanently stranded, reducing capital efficiency and diminishing potential profits for all kHYPE holders.
V.evidence_quote: Each time `redelegateWithdrawnHYPE` is used to re-delegate canceled withdrawal amounts, the rounding down in `_convertTo8Decimals`—without handling the remainder—causes `_cancelledWithdrawalAmount % 1e10` HYPE to be lost from the re-delegation process. This HYPE does not actually disappear from the system; it remains within the `StakingManager` contract (possibly in the contract’s ETH balance or an L1 account, depending on the fund flow implementation). However, it falls outside the protocol’s normal accounting and management mechanisms: it is neither recorded in `totalStaked`, explicitly tracked in `hypeBuffer`, nor delegated to validators to generate rewards.
